title: Sample 1
use_case_summary: Collect the reason for visit, symptoms, medications and allergies from adolescent patients before an appointment.
speech_profile: Adolescent · Male · Age 14y8m · Casual conversational speech · Frequent fillers and trailing sentences · Possible overlapping speakers
agent_purpose: A pediatric clinic voice agent that completes pre-visit intake with adolescent patients, covering reason for visit, symptoms, current medications, allergies, and recent changes in sleep, mood or appetite.
system_prompt: Transcribe the audio. Output only the transcript.

title: Sample 2
use_case_summary: Run a short, child-friendly wellness and symptom check-in with a parent or caregiver able to join.
agent_purpose: A pediatric voice agent that runs a short, child-friendly symptom and wellness check-in with school-age children, with a parent or caregiver able to join, and prepares a summary for the care team.
system_prompt: Transcribe the audio. Output only the transcript.

title: Sample 3
use_case_summary: Gather symptom details from adolescent callers after hours and route them to emergency care, a same-night nurse callback, or a next-day appointment.
agent_purpose: An after-hours pediatric nurse-line voice agent that gathers symptom details from adolescent callers and routes the call to the right level of care: emergency, same-night nurse callback, or next-day appointment.
system_prompt: Transcribe the audio. Output only the transcript.
